runtime_contract.backend: GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND selects json or postgres. Without an explicit backend, GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN or DATABASE_URL selects postgres. The resolved backend/DSN is passed directly to every canonical journal record store; no secondary factory silently defaults to JSON.
runtime_contract.packaged_boundary: Both Compose files set PANTHEON_DECISION_JOURNAL_REQUIRED_BACKEND=postgres. Even matching explicit json backend overrides are rejected before files are created, preventing a second BFF-local packaged authority. Isolated local JSON fixtures remain supported without this requirement.
runtime_contract.transport: Existing in-process typed adapter delegates to services.governance.decision_journal and governance.decision_journal_* Postgres tables. This is not a new journal service, HTTP transport, truth store or transaction engine.
runtime_contract.factory: AppDependencies creates the owner once. compose_bff_app passes an explicit getter to the real Agora router, retains the selected instance on app.state, and returns DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE/503 if it is absent or unhealthy. main.py no longer constructs a fallback owner or mutates the Agora service private getter after composition.
runtime_contract.storage: The shared governance consumer mount stays /data/governance:ro, including control overlay !override. /data/bff is writable for BFF state and the existing journal bundle lock. Journal records reside in the shared Postgres owner, not JSON under either mount.
runtime_contract.legacy: AGORA_GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND json/postgres is bounded compatibility; unsupported values and conflict with GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND are rejected. AGORA_GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN alone is explicitly rejected; operators must specify GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN or DATABASE_URL. Retired PANTHEON_BFF_DECISION_JOURNAL_STORE is removed from Compose and rejected by the writer resolver because canonical readers never consumed it. PANTHEON_DECISION_JOURNAL_DATA_DIR is the shared read/write path setting.
runtime_contract.unavailable: Unreachable Postgres with bootstrap disabled reports unhealthy and mounted POST returns 503/DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE. No JSON fallback or success receipt is created. Misconfigured backends fail startup. Read-only JSON denial preserves EROFS errno required by the accepted real-mount consumer contract.
